X-1.3.207.1.summary: Mundic applauds Luis de la Barra's decision to return: Ambassador (Henry Lane) Wilson considers it necessary that he come back soon to help.
X-1.3.207.1.en:
Telegram, Mexico to Paris, 13 February 1912, to Luis L. de la Barra, 9 rue Alfred de Vigny.

"I applaud [your decision that] you are resolved to return. Ambassador Wilson considers it necessary that you come
back soon to help. Mundic."

Repairs carried over from the reading: "resolved" (one letter added: resue{+l}vas), "Ambassador" (one letter changed),
"come back" (one letter changed). No holes.

X-1.3.239.1.summary: Explanations given, good impression; the situation uncertain; the general tendency a keen desire for peace.
X-1.3.239.1.en:
Telegram, Mexico to Paris, 15 March 1912, to Luis L. de la Barra.

"[H...] explanations, good impression. Situation uncertain; general tendency: a keen desire for peace. Mundic."

Hole carried over from the reading: the first letter (h) is not read.

system: Lower-case letter substitution of Spanish, 21 cipher letters seen. Two cipher letters stand for two plain letters each: n = t and u (both in situación), u = n and w (necesario, Wilson). Single exceptions read as slips: o = o once (embajador; i elsewhere), e =…
